name: alternate_titles
description: A list of alternate titles for this funder. Example: ["NSF"]

name: cited_by_count
description: The total number Works that cite a work linked to this funder.

name: country_code
description: The country where this funder is located, represented as an ISO two-letter country code. Example: US

name: counts_by_year
description: The values of works_count and cited_by_count for each of the last ten years, binned by year.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The year the counts refer to. Example: 2024

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works published in that year.

fields.name: cited_by_count
fields.description: Number of citations received in that year.

fields.name: oa_works_count
fields.description: Number of open access works linked to this funder in the given year.

name: created_date
description: The date this Funder object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. Example: 2017-08-08

name: description
description: A short description of this funder, taken from Wikidata.

name: display_name
description: The primary name of the funder. Example: National Science Foundation

name: grants_count
description: The number of grants linked to this funder. Example: (legacy name of awards_count)

name: homepage_url
description: The URL for this funder's primary homepage.

name: id
description: The OpenAlex ID for this funder. Example: https://openalex.org/F4320306076

name: ids
description: External identifiers OpenAlex holds for this funder. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible.

fields.name: openalex
fields.description: This funder's OpenAlex ID. Example: https://openalex.org/F4320306076

fields.name: ror
fields.description: This funder's ROR ID. Example: https://ror.org/021nxhr62

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: This funder's Wikidata ID. Example: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q304878

fields.name: crossref
fields.description: Crossref Funder Registry ID of the funder. Example: 100000001

fields.name: doi
fields.description: DOI of the funder (Crossref Funder Registry). Example: https://doi.org/10.13039/100000001

name: image_thumbnail_url
description: Same as image_url, but it's a smaller image.

name: image_url
description: URL of an image representing this funder, usually a logo or seal hosted on Wikimedia.

name: roles
description: List of role objects, which include the role (one of institution, funder, or publisher), the id (OpenAlex ID), and the works_count.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role this organisation plays in OpenAlex. Possible values: institution | funder | publisher

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the entity record for that role. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315, https://openalex.org/F4320306076, https://openalex.org/P4310320595

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works linked to the organisation in that role.

fields.name: 2yr_mean_citedness
fields.description: The 2-year mean citedness for this funder. Also known as impact factor. Example: 3.14

fields.name: h_index
fields.description: The h-index for this funder. Example: 42

fields.name: i10_index
fields.description: The i-10 index for this funder. Example: 120

name: updated_date
description: The last time anything in this funder object changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts. Example: 2026-10-12T05:31:44.211000

name: works_count
description: The number of works linked to this funder.

name: is_global_south
description: True if the funder is located in a Global South country. Possible values: true | false

name: awards_count
description: Number of awards from this funder in OpenAlex (replaces grants_count). Example: 500000
